extracted.name: Zucchini and Potato Bake
extracted.description: This zucchini and potato recipe takes lightly seasoned potatoes, zucchini, and red bell pepper and bakes them all together for an easy side dish.
ingredient_lines: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks
2 medium zucchini, quartered and cut into large pieces
1 medium red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Toss together potatoes, zucchini, red bell pepper, bread crumbs, olive oil, and garlic in a medium baking pan. Season with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and lightly brown, about 1 hour.
